intro: A handful of kerepek pisang gives about 170 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the oil absorbed when the banana is fried, plus sugar for the sweet version.
diet: Yes, a handful of kerepek pisang can fit into a weight loss plan. Even though it's from fruit, it's fried, so it's much higher in calories than a fresh banana. There's almost no protein, so you get hungry again fast. Have it as a small snack, not as a replacement for fruit.
tips: Pour one handful into a small bowl and keep the rest of the packet away.
Choose the salted version over sugar or chocolate-coated.
For an afternoon office snack, pair with low-fat milk or a boiled egg for protein.

swap.name: Fresh pisang berangan, 1 banana
swap.why: Same sweet banana taste, more water and fibre, no frying oil.

faq.q: Do banana chips count as fruit?
faq.a: Not really. Frying removes a lot of water and adds oil, so it's more of a snack than a serving of fruit.

faq.q: What bananas are usually used for kerepek?
faq.a: Pisang tanduk, pisang nangka and pisang awak are popular because their texture is good for slicing thin and frying.

faq.q: How do I keep banana chips from going lemau?
faq.a: Store in an airtight container or jar, away from damp places. Close it tightly every time after taking some.
